diarize_usage.stdout:
Usage: /home/chao/nemo-speech.cpp/build/cuda-diar/bin/nemo-speech diarize INPUT [--model MODEL] [options]

Diarize one WAV file or every WAV file in a directory. Concurrent
directory work shares one model and batches compatible GPU steps.

Options:
  -m, --model MODEL         Local Sortformer GGUF path
  --device, --backend DEVICE
                            auto, cpu, cuda[:N], metal, or vulkan[:N]
  --offline                 Full-attention mode for short audio
  --preset NAME             streaming or offline geometry
  --config FILE             Load diarization YAML configuration
  --format text|json|rttm   Output format (default: text)
  --recording-id NAME       RTTM recording id
  -o, --output PATH         Write output instead of stdout
  --output-dir DIR          Preserve directory layout under DIR
  -c, --concurrency N       Concurrent files; one shared model
  -r, --recursive           Recurse into input directories
  --onset VALUE             Speaker activation threshold
  --offset VALUE            Speaker deactivation threshold
  --pad-onset SECONDS       Extend segment starts
  --pad-offset SECONDS      Extend segment ends
  --min-duration-on SEC     Remove shorter speech segments
  --min-duration-off SEC    Fill shorter silence gaps
  --no-batching             Disable dynamic batching
  --force                   Replace existing output files
